description: The one Whispering window. It reads and writes Whispering's folder only through Whispering's own file commands (files_read, files_read_many, files_write, files_list, files_remove, files_change_folder, folder_git), which check each folder against the file system plugin's scope: the default folder (data/ in the app's local data directory, allowed at start) and one the person picked in the folder dialog (restored at each start by the persisted-scope plugin). It holds none of the file system plugin's commands, and no permission here names a folder. It shows the folder in Finder, sends a provider's requests to any http or https address with a key it reads from the Keychain (secret_get, secret_set), records from the shell's microphone and places each take in the folder, transcribes audio on this computer and administers the local models, and holds the global shortcut the page asks for (set_shortcut) and hears its presses (core:event).
